body: `tracingClientOutboundInterceptor` does not currently implement the new interceptor methods related to standalone activities. This results in not creating the client-side spans when executing activities.

comments.body: Opened a focused PR for this. It adds `ExecuteActivity` to `tracingClientOutboundInterceptor` so standalone activity client calls create a `StartActivity` span and write tracing context to the header.

title: Standalone Activities - tracing interceptor doesn't intercept standalone activities client calls
